## Background

<!-- What a reader needs to know to see why this matters. Two or three sentences. -->

## The problem

<!-- What is wrong now, concretely. Numbers if you have them. -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- What you think should happen. It is allowed to be wrong — that is what

## Expected outcome

<!-- What is different once this is done, stated so someone else could tell

## Validation method

     after the work. -->
